# mapbox search

Mapbox Search Box API

A curated subset of the Search Box API's public, non-interactive surface — forward and reverse geocoding of POIs and addresses, category search, and the category list.

4 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox search category

POIs filtered by a canonical category, near a location or route.

Returns only POIs belonging to the given canonical category — for example, all nearby coffee shops for `coffee`, or all gas stations along a route for `gas_station`.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/search/searchbox/v1/category/{category}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | `CATEGORY` | yes | string |  | The canonical category ID to search for. Sent in the request path. |
| `bbox` | `--bbox BBOX` | no | string |  | Limit results to those inside a bounding box, as `minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat`. Cannot cross the 180th meridian. Sent in the request query. |
| `country` | `--country COUNTRY` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of ISO 3166 alpha 2 country codes. Sent in the request query. |
| `eta-type` | `--eta-type ETA_TYPE` | no | string | `navigation` | Enable ETA calculation in the response. The only allowed value is `navigation`; also requires `navigation_profile` and either `origin` or `proximity`. Sent in the request query. |
| `exclude-fields` | `--exclude-fields EXCLUDE_FIELDS` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of metadata fields to omit from the response, to reduce payload size. Accepts `photos`, `reviews`. Sent in the request query. |
| `language` | `--language LANGUAGE` | no | string |  | The ISO language code to be returned. If not provided, the default is English. Sent in the request query. |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | no | integer |  | The number of results to return, up to 25. Sent in the request query. |
| `navigation-profile` | `--navigation-profile NAVIGATION_PROFILE` | no | string | `driving`, `walking`, `cycling` | When ETA calculation is enabled, the routing profile to use. Sent in the request query. |
| `near` | `--near NEAR` | no | string |  | Bias the response to favor results near a location described by free-form text (a place or city name) or a `longitude,latitude` coordinate pair. Sent in the request query. |
| `origin` | `--origin ORIGIN` | no | string |  | When ETA calculation is enabled, the location to calculate distance from, as `longitude,latitude`. Sent in the request query. |
| `poi-category-exclusions` | `--poi-category-exclusions POI_CATEGORY_EXCLUSIONS` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of canonical category names to exclude matching POIs. Sent in the request query. |
| `proximity` | `--proximity PROXIMITY` | no | string |  | Bias the response to favor results closer to a specific location. Sent in the request query. |
| `radius` | `--radius RADIUS` | no | number |  | Limit results to those within a radius, in degrees, of the `proximity` point. Also provide `proximity` when using this. Sent in the request query. |
| `route` | `--route ROUTE` | no | string |  | When SAR is enabled, a polyline-encoded linestring describing the route to search along. Sent in the request query. |
| `route-geometry` | `--route-geometry ROUTE_GEOMETRY` | no | string | `polyline`, `polyline6` | When SAR is enabled, the precision of `route` — `polyline` or `polyline6`. Defaults to `polyline`. Sent in the request query. |
| `sar-type` | `--sar-type SAR_TYPE` | no | string | `isochrone` | Enable search-along-route (SAR) requests around the path given by `route`. The only allowed value is `isochrone`. Sent in the request query. |
| `show-closed-pois` | `--show-closed-pois` | no | boolean |  | Set to true to include permanently closed points of interest. Excluded by default. Sent in the request query. |
| `time-deviation` | `--time-deviation TIME_DEVIATION` | no | number |  | When SAR is enabled, maximum detour allowed in estimated minutes from the route. Sent in the request query. |
| `types` | `--types TYPES` | no | string |  | Limit results to one or more feature types, comma-separated. Sent in the request query. |

```sh
mapbox search category CATEGORY
```

### mapbox search forward

Forward search for an address or POI by free-form text.

Returns a list of features matching the given search string, with coordinates and metadata. Unlike an autocomplete/suggest flow, this returns finished results directly from a single query — no session_token or follow-up retrieve call.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/search/searchbox/v1/forward`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto-complete` | `--auto-complete` | no | boolean |  | Set to true to enable Autocomplete Mode, which includes partial and fuzzy matches. Sent in the request query. |
| `bbox` | `--bbox BBOX` | no | string |  | Limit results to those inside a bounding box, as `minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat`. Cannot cross the 180th meridian. Sent in the request query. |
| `country` | `--country COUNTRY` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of ISO 3166 alpha 2 country codes. Sent in the request query. |
| `eta-type` | `--eta-type ETA_TYPE` | no | string | `navigation` | Enable ETA calculation in the response. The only allowed value is `navigation`; also requires `navigation_profile` and either `origin` or `proximity`. Sent in the request query. |
| `exclude-fields` | `--exclude-fields EXCLUDE_FIELDS` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of metadata fields to omit from the response, to reduce payload size. Accepts `photos`, `reviews`. Sent in the request query. |
| `language` | `--language LANGUAGE` | no | string |  | The ISO language code to be returned. If not provided, the default is English. Sent in the request query. |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | no | integer |  | The number of results to return, up to 10. Sent in the request query. |
| `minimum-rating` | `--minimum-rating MINIMUM_RATING` | no | number |  | Limit results to those with an average rating of at least this value, if rating data is available. Between 0.0 and 5.0. Sent in the request query. |
| `navigation-profile` | `--navigation-profile NAVIGATION_PROFILE` | no | string | `driving`, `walking`, `cycling` | When ETA calculation is enabled, the routing profile to use. Sent in the request query. |
| `near` | `--near NEAR` | no | string |  | Bias the response to favor results near a location described by free-form text (a place or city name) or a `longitude,latitude` coordinate pair. Overrides `proximity` when resolved. Sent in the request query. |
| `open-now` | `--open-now` | no | boolean |  | Set to true to limit results to POIs open now, based on hours of operation, if available. Sent in the request query. |
| `origin` | `--origin ORIGIN` | no | string |  | When ETA calculation is enabled, the location to calculate distance from, as `longitude,latitude`. Sent in the request query. |
| `poi-category` | `--poi-category POI_CATEGORY` | no | string |  | Limit results to those in one or more categories, comma-separated. Sent in the request query. |
| `poi-category-exclusions` | `--poi-category-exclusions POI_CATEGORY_EXCLUSIONS` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of canonical category names to exclude matching POIs. Sent in the request query. |
| `price-levels` | `--price-levels PRICE_LEVELS` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of price levels to limit results to, if price data is available. Accepts `$`, `$$`, `$$$`, `$$$$`. Sent in the request query. |
| `proximity` | `--proximity PROXIMITY` | no | string |  | Bias the response to favor results closer to a specific location. Sent in the request query. |
| `q` | `--q Q` | yes | string |  | The user's query string. Limited to 256 characters. Sent in the request query. |
| `radius` | `--radius RADIUS` | no | number |  | Limit results to those within a radius, in degrees, of the `proximity` point. Also provide `proximity` when using this. Sent in the request query. |
| `rank-strategy` | `--rank-strategy RANK_STRATEGY` | no | string | `distance`, `relevance` | Change how results are ranked. Only applies to data sources that support it. Sent in the request query. |
| `route` | `--route ROUTE` | no | string |  | When SAR is enabled, a polyline-encoded linestring describing the route to search along. Sent in the request query. |
| `route-geometry` | `--route-geometry ROUTE_GEOMETRY` | no | string | `polyline`, `polyline6` | When SAR is enabled, the precision of `route` — `polyline` or `polyline6`. Defaults to `polyline`. Sent in the request query. |
| `sar-type` | `--sar-type SAR_TYPE` | no | string | `isochrone` | Enable search-along-route (SAR) requests around the path given by `route`. The only allowed value is `isochrone`. Sent in the request query. |
| `show-closed-pois` | `--show-closed-pois` | no | boolean |  | Set to true to include permanently closed points of interest. Excluded by default. Sent in the request query. |
| `time-deviation` | `--time-deviation TIME_DEVIATION` | no | number |  | When SAR is enabled, maximum detour allowed in estimated minutes from the route. Sent in the request query. |
| `types` | `--types TYPES` | no | string |  | Limit results to one or more feature types, comma-separated. Sent in the request query. |

```sh
mapbox search forward --q Q
```

### mapbox search list-category

The canonical category IDs usable with `search category`.

Returns every canonical category ID and display name in the given language. Does not describe parent/child relationships between categories.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/search/searchbox/v1/list/category`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | `--language LANGUAGE` | no | string |  | The ISO language code to be returned. If not provided, the default is English. Sent in the request query. |

```sh
mapbox search list-category
```

### mapbox search reverse

Reverse lookup for the addresses and POIs at a coordinate.

Returns the geographic feature or features at the given coordinate.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/search/searchbox/v1/reverse`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `country` | `--country COUNTRY` | no | string |  | A comma-separated list of ISO 3166 alpha 2 country codes. Sent in the request query. |
| `language` | `--language LANGUAGE` | no | string |  | The ISO language code to be returned. If not provided, the default is English. Sent in the request query. |
| `latitude` | `--latitude LATITUDE` | yes | number |  | The latitude coordinate to search near. Sent in the request query. |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | no | integer |  | The number of results to return, up to 10. Sent in the request query. |
| `longitude` | `--longitude LONGITUDE` | yes | number |  | The longitude coordinate to search near. Sent in the request query. |
| `show-closed-pois` | `--show-closed-pois` | no | boolean |  | Set to true to include permanently closed points of interest. Excluded by default. Sent in the request query. |
| `types` | `--types TYPES` | no | string |  | Limit results to one or more feature types, comma-separated. Sent in the request query. |

```sh
mapbox search reverse --latitude 0 --longitude 0
```
